name: tokens
title: Gamestage tokens
description: The design tokens every Gamestage component reads: colour, type, depth, motion, sound and haptic intent, plus the arcade theme. Install this first. Components read these variables and never define a colour themselves, so a theme change reaches every surface. It also ships the shared rule sets a component includes so a theme axis reaches it without the component re-declaring every property by hand. Renders nothing, creates no DOM and sets no root attribute. It supplies CSS variables, and sound and haptic intent as JSON; it does not play a sound or fire a haptic, and it is the host that sets the theme and context attributes on its own DOM. It pulls in `fonts` as a registry dependency, whose stylesheet is imported before this one.
docs: Import gamestage-tokens.css, gamestage-primitives.css and gamestage-motion.css once at the root, in that order. Set data-gs-theme="arcade" for the arcade look and data-gs-context="light" for a light surface. motion.css carries the design's eleven keyframes and applies one to any element carrying data-gs-motion; without it a score that should pop and a wrong answer that should shake simply appear.
